move: purple speech bubble slams down, squashes, glitch ghosts split, eyes blink and glance, jumps out
how: A purple SVG speech-bubble glyph with two dark rect eyes, two offset ghost copies (darker and lighter purple), a purple radial glow, a red LIVE NOW badge and three chat lines. 0-14%: the bubble falls from y -520 stretched (scaleY 1.2, scaleX .85) with power3.in, lands at 14% squashing to scaleY .78/scaleX 1.18 from its bottom origin (0.12s) and springs upright with elastic.out(1,.35) over 0.7s while the glow blooms from scale .4 (expo.out); at 14.5% the ghosts jump +-22px for 0.05s and ease back to 0 fading (expo.out). Eyes blink (scaleY .1, 0.08/0.12s) at 35% and 77%, glance x +4/-4/0 between 45% and 77% while the head rotates -5, 4, 0 (power2.inOut). At 22% the badge pops with back.out(3) and its dot blinks yoyo; from 30% the chat lines slide in from x -40 with a 0.35s stagger. Exit at 86%: anticipation squash, then the bubble launches to y -560 (power3.in), the glow fades and the UI drops 20px fading.
adapt: Replace the Twitch purple (#9146ff) and the bubble path with the product mark, the badge text, the chat handles and messages. Keep the power3.in drop with 0.12s landing squash, the elastic.out(1,.35) settle and the 0.05s ghost split.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the wrap with ghosts, the badge and chat lines inside el; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with the landing at 0.14D, blinks at 0.35D/0.77D, badge at 0.22D, exit at 0.86D. Scope '.wrap', '.ghost', '.eye', '.badge', '.chat div' to el; the y -520/-560 travel assumes a 1080px stage; from() tweens on badge and chat need immediateRender:false when nested.
caveats: drop and exit distances assume a 1080px-tall frame
from() tweens need immediateRender:false when nested
